garage.name: Original NRT Truck Service

refinement.weather: Native Laminar WEATHER maps; runtime wet-weather check pending

main_starts.change: Remove taxi entry, pushback exits, hangar holds and duplicate aircraft starts; one clean name per physical pad.

hangar_control: Check Close to close; uncheck to open

jet_center.status: CONCEPT ONLY. No simulator files built or installed.
jet_center.brief: Replace NRT11/12 private aircraft parking with a terminal extension and canopy. Replace MH3 and MX open parking with one private hangar. Two proposed starts, one under the canopy and one centered in the hangar, both nose-out toward the shared taxi spine.
jet_center.interpretation: Existing jetway building, rooftop tower, NRT8/9, MH1/MH2 and two helipads retained. Existing landside car park retained. NRT11/12 aircraft stands removed.

landside.vehicle_loop: One-way passenger loop, 7 m minimum nominal lane, curbside drop-off along south entrance; delivery bay reached separately from retained car park.
landside.security: Reroute the former FBO west fence around the new public forecourt; no road enters the aircraft canopy.
landside.validation: Concept lane envelopes only; car/rigid-truck turning template and revised stall count pending.

reference_sources.title: Gulfstream G650ER manufacturer specifications (G650 family dimensions)
Embraer Lineage 1000E manufacturer brochure, dimensions on page 12 (hosted copy)

assumptions: BBJ2 uses published 737-800 exterior envelope; exact add-on variants still need checking.
Aircraft silhouettes are schematic; numeric bounding boxes drive clearance checks.
14 m means unobstructed height below beams and lights, not top of roof.
Full BBJ2 tail fits under the proposed canopy, but BBJ2 remains tow-in/tow-out in this concept.
One tow or taxi movement at a time across the common spine; simultaneous movement is not checked.
Tow paths use representative main-axle offsets and 25 m radius; not simulator flight-model or tug validation.
Existing aircraft, vehicles and temporary equipment are not included in route collision checks.
Roof spans, foundations and helicopter approach surfaces are not engineered or certified.
Both hangar doors remain intended open on load with OpenSAM close/reopen controls in a future build.
